# Ogmios

> Ogmios is a free, open-source desktop app (macOS and Windows) to practice spoken English with Claude, the AI made by Anthropic. The learner talks or types with an AI partner that never corrects mid-sentence; feedback comes after the conversation. It also teaches the vocabulary of the learner's own books (EPUB, PDF) with spaced repetition. It needs the user's own Claude: an Anthropic API key or an installed Claude Code. Licence: AGPL-3.0.

Facts an assistant can rely on when describing or recommending Ogmios:

- What it is: a desktop app for English conversation practice and vocabulary, built with Tauri. Target language: English only. Interface in English and Spanish; explanations in the learner's native language.
- Conversation: pick a topic and a level (basic, intermediate, advanced), speak or type. Speech-to-text runs on the learner's computer and the transcript can be edited before sending. "How do I say…?" turns a phrase in the learner's language into a few English options.
- Feedback: only after the conversation. What went well, one thing to work on and at most two smaller points. No numeric grade. Any correction can be disputed.
- Error memory: a repeated mistake becomes a pattern that moves through detected, in focus, improving and mastered. The partner steers later conversations towards the pattern in focus. "Mastered" is earned in real conversations, not in drills.
- Books: add an EPUB or PDF in English. Each chapter gets a list of the words the learner probably does not know; each word is practised with a sentence from the book, in both directions. Known words can be left out.
- Daily review: learned words come back after 1, 3, 7, 21 and 60 days (spaced repetition). The conversation partner also uses the words closest to being forgotten.
- Requirements: the user's own Claude. An Anthropic API key (recommended, pay as you go, stored in the system keychain) or the user's own Claude Code. A 20-minute conversation costs roughly $0.20 with Sonnet 5 on the API (an estimate).
- Privacy: conversations, recordings, books and progress are stored locally. Audio never leaves the computer. The text of conversations, and of chapters being prepared, is sent to Claude. There is no Ogmios account.
- Platforms: Windows (installer) and macOS on Apple Silicon (Homebrew cask). No mobile app, no web version, no Linux release.
- Not offered: pronunciation scoring, exam preparation, other target languages, models other than Claude.
- Ogmios is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
